roles.machine: proof/data field: counter hue to action

presets.name: signal
presets.label: Signal (reference reel)
presets.notes: The reference reel. Red-orange takes ink text, ultramarine takes bone text. Never put action and machine against each other as text/background.

presets.name: acid
presets.label: Acid (lime / ultramarine)
presets.notes: Lime is a light action: it needs INK text, never bone (bone on lime is ~1.2:1). Unbounded has no wdth axis; swap to Anybody if the reel uses kinetic width.

presets.name: cargo
presets.label: Cargo (amber / cobalt)
presets.notes: Safety-amber statements, cobalt data scenes. Amber is light enough that bone text on it fails; always ink.

presets.name: kiln
presets.label: Kiln (terracotta / deep teal)
presets.notes: Editorial and earthy. Warm paper bone carries most long-form scenes; teal proof scenes read as print ink. Syne has no wdth axis.

presets.name: flamingo
presets.label: Flamingo (hot pink / teal)
presets.notes: Hot pink takes ink text. Pink and teal vibrate at similar luminance: never text-on-background between them.

presets.name: bloom
presets.label: Bloom (emerald / violet)
presets.notes: Growth green statements with violet proof scenes. Flat fields only: no green-to-violet gradients.

presets.name: arctic
presets.label: Arctic (signal red / deep sky)
presets.notes: Cool bone and blue-black ink. Red takes ink text, sky blue takes bone text.

presets.name: obsidian
presets.label: Obsidian (monochrome + gold)
presets.notes: Monochrome with a single accent. Machine is a warm mid-grey: use it for quiet proof scenes. Sequence mostly ink/bone; gold action is rare and precious. Lexend Zetta is already ultra-wide and has no wdth axis.

presets.name: solar
presets.label: Solar (orange / violet)
presets.notes: Maximum warmth against a deep violet. Orange takes ink text; violet takes bone.

presets.name: orchard
presets.label: Orchard (tomato / forest)
presets.notes: Market-stall red and deep forest. Red and green are near-equal in luminance: never text-on-background between them.

presets.name: candy
presets.label: Candy (bubblegum / navy)
presets.notes: Bubblegum is a light action: ink text only, and bone-on-bubblegum is forbidden. Navy is nearly as dark as ink, so alternate navy with bone or action, not with ink.

presets.name: voltage
presets.label: Voltage (electric yellow / graphite)
presets.notes: Ink-heavy: most scenes are ink, yellow hits are the punctuation. Yellow is light: ink text only. Graphite machine is close to ink in value, so do not cut ink to machine back to back.

presets.name: apothecary
presets.label: Apothecary (maroon / sage)
presets.notes: Inverted polarity: the action field is DARK (bone text) and machine sage is LIGHT (ink text). Slow cuts suit it; keep grain soft.

presets.name: clinic
presets.label: Clinic (aqua mint / crimson)
presets.notes: Clinical aqua takes ink text; crimson proof scenes take bone text. Cool bone keeps it lab-clean.

presets.name: ledger
presets.label: Ledger (cobalt / deep teal)
presets.notes: Analogous-dark machine for a calm, trustworthy read. Cobalt is bright enough for ink text; deep teal takes bone.
